text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After finishing the fierce battle of the Arima Kinen,
I returned to the academy with Kiseki—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Welcome back, Kiseki-san!
Trainer-san!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Congratulations on achieving the Fall Senior Triple Crown!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, Trainer.
Thank you for buying mine too.
choice_data_list: Oh, no need to thank me.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I should be the one apologizing for making you wait out in the cold!
And... thank you so much for coming all this way to congratulate me!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
No, no, not at all!
I mean, we're talking about the Autumn Senior Triple Crown here, right?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Having challenged it myself, I know just how steep of a summit it is!
And Kiseki-san conquered it!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
...I feel like I've suddenly been
completely left behind.
Around this time last year, I thought we were side-by-side.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
What?!
No, no, I was nowhere close last year!
Only now am I finally getting there...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...Isn't that just about enough to overtake Kita-chan?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: See, you totally passed me after all!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki & Kitasan
text_block_list.text: ...Fufufu!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I was amazing this year, wasn't I! It was fun to watch, right, Kita-chan?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Yes, very much so!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Kiseki-san's running style
just keeps constantly evolving!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Every time I saw you in races or on the news,
my heart felt all warm inside. I just knew
you had to be working super hard!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Ah. By the way, speaking of my time off, when I got to tour a training club through Duramente-san's connections...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Kiseki-san, you were super popular with the kids!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Huh, seriously?!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Ai-san's the strong one,
but apparently Kiseki-san is the funny one!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh, I'm the one who won the Autumn Senior Triple Crown, you know?!
I'm the strongest AND the most entertaining one here, right?!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Now, now. So when I asked various people
about Kiseki-san...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: "...I felt like I couldn't afford to lose either, so my energy's totally recharged."

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Huh!? Does that mean...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I'll make my return next year.
Not that I had planned on doing so, though.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: ...So next time, I'll be your rival too. Come at me with everything you've got, Kiseki-san!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Let's meet on the turf next time then!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Mm-hmm! Good night, Kita-chan!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Eeeeehhk!?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: "Because! Kitasan Black making a comeback is a huge deal, isn't it?! It's massive news!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
And she's totally raring to race against me...!
Th-This is—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
“—My work next year is definitely
going to be amazing too, isn't it?!”

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Right?! Isn't it?!
Kuuuugh～～～～...!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Looks like there's still more depth to my story
than I thought...!
choice_data_list: You never fail to amaze me, Kiseki!
You never fail to amaze me, Kiseki!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: No, no, not at all...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
No, maybe I don't need to be so modest...?
Maybe it's okay if they shower me with compliments...?
choice_data_list: That's right, I'll praise you! You're the best!
That's right, I'll praise you! You're amazing!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fuhi... ehehehe...! 
Thank you very mu~ch!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Haaah... It's so hot...! Fuu... My heart is thumping so hard...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"...So, Trainer.
If it's a race against Kita-chan,
which idea sounds more interesting: Front Runner or Late Charger?"
choice_data_list: You're going to draw the storyboard now?
You're gonna draw the storyboard now?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Why not~?!
My fire's been lit!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
With these legs of mine,
I'll go further, even more, even further—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: —I'll make sure to blow you away!
